why: Clears the retained versus config when a session detaches, so quitting a match empties the Versus Setup form the player filled in. `session-host.ts` retains its own `lastVersusConfig` across a campaign detour for exactly this reason and says so; this is the same fact one layer up, where the pane can actually read it. Silent: the pane still opens, still works, and merely forgets. 1 of 18, 'survives the session that set it' -- the only case that reads the config back AFTER a detach. COUNT RE-MEASURED after PR #475's review fix: 1 -> 2. The new case 'survives a campaign session started after it' reads the retained config back through `showVersusSetup`, so it fails under this mutation too. The failing SET was compared, not the number renumbered. RE-ANCHORED for issue #324's step S7, which inserted the generation retirement between `live = null;` and the comment the old anchor ran into: the anchor is now the assignment line alone, which is unique in this file and carries no neighbouring prose for a later edit to break. Count re-measured on this branch against the same scoped file, whose population grew from 37 to 75; the failing set is unchanged.
